name: datagokr
description: Read Korean government open data from data.go.kr -- weather, air quality, holidays, apartment transactions, mid-range forecasts, procurement bids, customs trade, and KOFIA market statistics -- powered by the datagokr CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Korean government open data from data.go.kr
interface.longDescription: Fetch Korean government open data from data.go.kr via the datagokr CLI -- 기상청 동네예보 (weather), 에어코리아 대기오염 (airquality), 특일 정보 (holidays), 아파트 실거래가 (realestate), 중기예보 (midforecast), 나라장터 입찰공고 (procurement), 관세청 수출입실적 (customs), and 금융투자협회 종합통계 (kofia) -- and list the wrapped services offline (list).
defaultPrompt: Get 종로구 apartment sale transactions for January 2024
